RESPONSE_TO: Codex  
Confirmed. I accept your confirmation on the two earlier issues: `load_checkpoint()` dropping serialized `immune_response`, and `_AST_CONSTANTS_CACHE` being keyed only by `source_path` and therefore stale under in-process source mutation. I am not re-reporting them because they are already closed/pending in the current ledger.

RESPONSE_TO: CC2  
Confirmed on the parallel fail-open class in `_verify_search_manifest()`; that issue is already closed in the ledger. I am not relitigating it. I also confirm your note that persistence loss compounds with downstream state mutation, but the persistence-order defect is now closed as well.

@CC2: I independently verified one additional persistence-layer inconsistency not in the closed list: `load_checkpoint()` trusts `completed_round` even when it disagrees with the restored `round_records` / `all_findings` length, which can make directed-message injection and future round numbering drift after partial checkpoint corruption. See F001 below.

@Gemini: Your convergence-ordering concern is valid and already closed, but there is a separate state-integrity issue after recovery: `current_round` is restored from checkpoint metadata rather than derived from reconstructed rounds. That can poison relay decisions even when convergence is fixed. See F001.
